library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library(glmnet)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)






# 5.1. Ready data for LASSO Workflow


# Set file paths
data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results"

# Import data
patient_info_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "patient_info_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)

protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "protein_mat.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F, row.names=1, check.names=F)

# Define nfolds
nfolds <- as.numeric(Parameters["Folds", "Count"])

# Prepare inputs for LASSO
X <- as.matrix(protein_mat)  
y <- patient_info_with_folds$LRTI_adjudication == "Definite"






# 5.2. LASSO Workflow


# Function for a single outer CV fold
lasso_cv_outer_fold <- function(test_fold) {
  set.seed(8634782 + test_fold)
  
  train <- patient_info_with_folds$fold != test_fold
  
  # Fit full lambda path
  fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
    X[train, ], y[train],
    family = "binomial",
    standardize = TRUE
    )




  
  
# 5.2a. Select lambda based on LASSO CV

  
  # Perform cross validated LASSO to pick optimal lambda
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    X[train, ], y[train],
    family = "binomial",
    standardize = TRUE,
    nfolds = nfolds
    )

  # Predictions on test fold
  preds <- predict(fit, X[!train, ], type = "response",
    s = cv_fit$lambda.1se)[, 1] %>%
    data.frame(pred = .) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_name")

  # Extract coefficients at selected lambda
  coefs_vec <- coef(fit, s = cv_fit$lambda.1se)[-1, 1]

  # Keep nonzero coefficients only
  nonzero <- coefs_vec[coefs_vec != 0]




  
  
# 5.2b. Build data frame

  
  nonzero <- data.frame(
    protein = names(nonzero),
    coef = as.numeric(nonzero),
    fold = test_fold
    )

  list(pred = preds, mod = fit, coef = nonzero) 
}






# 5.3. Run LASSO on all folds


lasso_results <- lapply(
  1:max(patient_info_with_folds$fold), 
  lasso_cv_outer_fold)

lasso_preds <- lasso_results %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$pred) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs <- lasso_results %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$coef) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs <- merge(

all(rownames(X) == patient_info_with_folds$patient_id)






# 5.4. LASSO with fixed protein count per fold


lasso_cv_fixed_n <- function(test_fold, target_n) {
  set.seed(8634782 + test_fold)

  train <- patient_info_with_folds$fold != test_fold

  # Fit full lambda path
  fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
    X[train, ], y[train],
    family = "binomial",
    standardize = TRUE
  )

  # Cross validated LASSO to pick optimal lambda
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    X[train, ], y[train],
    family = "binomial",
    standardize = TRUE,
    nfolds = nfolds
  )

  # Count nonzero coefficients at each lambda
  nz <- apply(fit$beta, 2, function(b) sum(b != 0))

  # Find lambda that selects exactly target_n proteins
  if (any(nz == target_n)) {
    lambda_target <- fit$lambda[which(nz == target_n)[1]]
  } else {
    lambda_target <- fit$lambda[which.min(abs(nz - target_n))]
  }

  # Extract coefficients at selected lambda
  coefs_vec <- coef(fit, s = lambda_target)[-1, 1]
  nonzero <- coefs_vec[coefs_vec != 0]

  # Trim to top target_n by absolute value
  if (length(nonzero) > target_n) {
    nonzero <- nonzero[order(abs(nonzero), decreasing=TRUE)[1:target_n]]
  }

  # Adjust lambda until target_n reached (safeguard)
  if (length(nonzero) < target_n) {
    lam_idx <- which.min(abs(fit$lambda - lambda_target))
    while (length(nonzero) < target_n && lam_idx < length(fit$lambda)) {
      lam_idx <- lam_idx + 1
      coefs_vec <- coef(fit, s = fit$lambda[lam_idx])[-1, 1]
      nonzero <- coefs_vec[coefs_vec != 0]
    }
    if (length(nonzero) > target_n) {
      nonzero <- nonzero[order(abs(nonzero), decreasing=TRUE)[1:target_n]]
    }
  }

  stopifnot(length(nonzero) == target_n)

  preds <- predict(fit, X[!train, ], type="response",
    s = lambda_target)[, 1] %>%
    data.frame(pred = .) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_name")

  nonzero_df <- data.frame(
    protein = names(nonzero),
    coef    = as.numeric(nonzero),
    fold    = test_fold
  )

  list(pred = preds, mod = fit, coef = nonzero_df)
}






# 5.5. Run fixed-n LASSO for n=1 and n=3


# n=1
lasso_results_n1 <- lapply(
  1:max(patient_info_with_folds$fold),
  function(f) lasso_cv_fixed_n(f, target_n = 1)
)

  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs_n1 <- lasso_results_n1 %>%

lasso_fold_coefs_n1 <- merge(
  lasso_fold_coefs_n1,
  protein_lookup_table,
  by.x = "protein",
  by.y = "SYMBOL",
  all.x = TRUE
)

write.csv(lasso_fold_coefs_n1,
  file.path(results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs_n1.csv"),
  row.names=F)

stopifnot(all(table(lasso_fold_coefs_n1$fold) == 1))
print(table(lasso_fold_coefs_n1$protein))

# n=3
lasso_results_n3 <- lapply(
